extension.summary: Live outdoor webcams from around the world
extension.description: Turns an idle TV into a window onto live outdoor scenes: beaches, mountains, lakes, harbours and towns, rotating through public camera feeds from the Live-Environment-Streams dataset (github.com/william-ricchiuti/Live-Environment-Streams). It favours places where it is daytime right now and high-quality streams, skips dead or stalled feeds by itself and remembers them, and shows a small overlay with the place, the source and the local time there. Any key exits straight away. If your own video or music is paused, it shows only a clock and never touches it. Streams play muted by default.
extension.disclaimer: Camera list: Live-Environment-Streams by William Ricchiuti, fetched at run time. The feeds belong to their owners (source shown on screen); this add-on only plays their public streams and records nothing.
